KOUSHIKA R
+91 6380836109 | koushika.r96@gmail.com
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/koushika-r-62743037
GitHub: github.com/koushikar96-ctrl
CAREER OBJECTIVE
B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science with a strong foundation in programming, software de-
velopment, and problem solving. Aspiring to build scalable software solutions while contributing effectively to
collaborative engineering teams and continuously enhancing technical skills.
EDUCATION
B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science 2023 – 2027
Mepco Schlenk Engineering College, Sivakasi CGPA: 8.38/10
Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) 2023
P. S. Chidambara Nadar Senior English School 89%
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming Languages: Python, Java, C, C++, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
Core Concepts: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Operating Sys-
tems, Database Management Systems, Machine Learning
Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Neo4j
PROJECTS
- Travel Buddy – Full Stack Travel Planning Platform
Built a MERN-based travel planning application with OTP authentication and AI trip planning.
Integrated Open-Meteo API, Cloudinary, chatbot, and user profile management.
- AI-Based Restaurant Recommendation System
Developed a Streamlit application for personalized restaurant recommendations.
Implemented AI-based questionnaires, filtering, and interactive visualizations.
- Hallucination Detection System
Developed an NLP-based system to identify hallucinated responses generated by Large Language Models.
Implemented text similarity and semantic analysis techniques to improve response reliability.
- Smart Posture Monitoring System
Developed an IoT-based system to monitor sitting posture using sensors.
Generated real-time alerts to encourage correct posture and reduce health risks.
- Disk Scheduling Visualizer
Implemented FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, CSCAN, and LOOK disk scheduling algorithms in C.
Visualized disk head movement and compared algorithm performance.
CERTIFICATIONS
- Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
- Infosys Springboard – Machine Learning with Python
- Deloitte – Cybersecurity Job Simulation
- MongoDB University – MongoDB Basics Certification (CRUD Operations)
- Elewayte – Web Development Certification
PAPER PRESENTATION
- Presented the paper titled ”Smart Agriculture using IoT and Artificial Intelligence” at a National Level Sympo-
sium organized by Rathinam Engineering College, Coimbatore.
ACHIEVEMENTS
- Grand Finalist – Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 (Software Edition), contributing to the development of a
Digital Twin-based real-time forecasting solution.
